result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations on rationalising the relation $\sqrt{x\xi}+\sqrt{y\eta}+\sqrt{z\zeta}=0$ under $x+y+z+\xi+\eta+\zeta=0$, tables of binary characteristics (theta characteristics) assigned to square-root expressions, some congruence-type arithmetic with $w=2n+2p-2$, and bilinear expressions in quantities $K, L, K', L'$.

methods.what: Rationalising a sum of three square roots under a linear constraint, rewriting as relation among other square roots
Assignment of theta characteristics (binary 2x3 arrays) to square roots of linear forms
Generalised three-term square-root relation with parameters
Genus-type count relation (Riemann–Hurwitz style) for coverings
Bilinear alternating form (period relation) and its invariance under transformation of periods
